story.skycraft.q.pl_brinewater_grotto.ou: The grotto mouth stays dark at night now, as a sea cave should.
story.skycraft.q.pl_brinewater_grotto.pi: There's a crew in Brinewater Grotto that makes shipwrecks happen. Hroar, they call the leader. Saltjaw. If somebody shut his jaw for good, the docks would drink to them for a month.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_helm_hollow.d: The bandits of Broken Helm Hollow nail the helmets of their victims to the wall. One belonged to Arnbjorn of the Riften guard, who went there alone on his day off.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_helm_hollow.o: Clear the bandits out of Broken Helm Hollow
There was an empty nail next to it, freshly hammered. Ingvild had been expecting another guest.
Take Arnbjorn's helm down from the trophy wall
Arnbjorn's helm will go home to his family in Riften. The empty nail in Broken Helm Hollow will stay empty.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_helm_hollow.p: Arnbjorn of the guard went to Broken Helm Hollow by himself. His helm's on their wall now. His brother Torbjorn won't stop staring south.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_limb_camp.des: Gralfr Bark-Back, foreman of Mixwater Mill, has put a bounty on a one-tusked giant from Broken Limb Camp who has been smashing his carts.
Beside the giants' pool is a small cairn with a mammoth calf's milk-tooth on top. A carter's unsent letter in the camp's refuse tells the rest: Gralfr and his men killed the calf for its tusks.
Find the one-tusked giant at Broken Limb Camp
One-Tusk came at me from the cairn. It did not stop until it fell, and it fell facing the stones.
Take the coin and say nothing.
Good. Good. Pleasure doing business. Mind how you go.
Tell him you know about the calf.
...Who told you? Sten? Sten can't keep his mouth shut in a gale. Fine. Fine! Keep the coin, and keep your mouth shut too, and I'll... I'll pay the oxen-men double. Satisfied?
Ha! I knew it. Two hundred septims, as promised. Here. ...Why are you looking at me like that?
Collect from Gralfr at Mixwater Mill
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_limb_camp.off: I heard there's a bounty on a giant.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_limb_camp.out: The cairn by the Broken Limb pools still stands. The giants walk around it every night.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_limb_camp.pit: One-tusked brute from Broken Limb Camp smashed two of my carts and drowned my oxen. Two hundred septims for its toes. Don't ask me why it started. Giants don't need reasons.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_oar_grotto.de: Aulus Carvain of the East Empire Company wants Captain Rhosen Varo, the smuggler of Broken Oar Grotto, dealt with for good.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_oar_grotto.o0: Find Broken Oar Grotto on the northern shore
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_oar_grotto.o2: Varo is dead. In his ledger, the bribes to the Castle Dour key-keeper are written out to the copper.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_oar_grotto.ou: The Company tows Varo's stolen ship back to Solitude and paints a new name on her. Aulus asks you to choose it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_oar_grotto.pi: There's a man called Rhosen Varo who used to captain for us. Now he captains against us, from a cave on the north shore with a stolen ship in it. He buys everything the wreckers steal. End him, and the Company will remember you kindly. That's rarer than gold.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_tower_redoubt: Bergljot of Karthwasten asked me to rescue her brother Hrofi from the Forsworn at Broken Tower Redoubt.
Hrofi's cage was open and empty. Under the furs of a Reachwoman's bed lay a letter in his hand. He was not taken. He chose.
He... chose them. Over us. Over Mother. No. Not over us. Over the Silver-Bloods. I can't even say he's wrong. Thank you for not lying to me.
Then I'll cut his name on the family stone. At least he didn't die a slave. Thank you for telling me.
Say it. Whatever it is, say it plainly.
Tell Bergljot what became of Hrofi
Who do the Forsworn shout about at night?
Whatever Bergljot believes, the Forsworn have stopped shouting Hrofi's name from the ridge.
My brother. Hrofi. They took him up to Broken Tower Redoubt in Sun's Height, and every few nights they yell his name from the ridge so we know he's still theirs. I can't pay much. Bring him home.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_tusk_mine.des: Rieklings drove the miners out of Broken Tusk Mine. Foreman Hrefna's ledger says the claim stone bearing the Jarl's seal is still in the strongbox in the bottom gallery.
Clear the rieklings out of Broken Tusk Mine
Topple the riekling who sits on the ore-cart throne
Recover the claim stone from the bottom gallery
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_tusk_mine.out: Hrefna has her mine back and has hung a new tusk over the door. The rieklings, from a ridge nearby, are drawing pictures of it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_broken_tusk_mine.pit: Rieklings took Broken Tusk Mine. Hrefna the foreman says that without the claim stone from the bottom gallery, the Company will say the mine is anyone's. Bring it back and she'll cut you in.
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.desc: The Dunmer alchemist Idrin Sarethi lost his satchel of recipes in Brood Cavern, in the web of a frost-white spider the size of a cart. He offers what he has for its return.
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.o0.text: Kill the White Mother of Brood Cavern
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.o1.text: Cut Idrin's satchel free of the web
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.o2.repl: My notes! All of them! Oh, you've no idea. Here, take what's in the purse, and this: never mix frostbite venom with deathbell, whatever anyone tells you. That alone is worth more than the gold.
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.o2.text: Return the satchel to Idrin Sarethi in Morthal
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.o2.topi: Your satchel. The White Mother won't be needing it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.outro: Idrin Sarethi's shop reopens with a new sign: 'Now With Spider.'
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.pitch: Idrin, the Dunmer who sells salves in Morthal, came back from Brood Cavern white as milk. Left two years of recipes in there with the biggest spider he's ever seen. He'll pay. Not much. But he'll pay.
story.skycraft.q.pl_brood_cavern.title: The White Mother
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.desc: Ancilia Varro, a Dwemer scholar in Markarth, sent her assistant Fennick to Bthardamz. He has not returned, and neither has her lexicon.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.o1.text: Destroy the warden of the great hall
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.o2.journal: The lexicon came free with a hiss of steam. There was no sign of Fennick but a trail of ink-stained footprints heading for the exit.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.o2.text: Take the lexicon from the slot by the great hall door
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.o3.reply: Because Fennick limped through my door last night and fainted on the rug. He's unsacked, by the way. He copied the whole great hall from inside a pipe. Ridiculous boy. Thank you. Truly.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.o3.text: Return the lexicon to Ancilia Varro in Markarth
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.outro: Ancilia's monograph on Bthardamz will have a footnote thanking you, and a much longer one complaining about Fennick.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.pitch: Fennick. Brilliant, careless, and Breton. I sent him to copy the gate of Bthardamz and he took my best lexicon inside. If you find Fennick, tell him he's sacked. If you find the lexicon, bring it to me. In that order of importance, I'm afraid. No, the other order. I'm upset.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bthardamz.title: The Lexicon in the Slot
story.skycraft.q.pl_bujolds_retreat.desc: Reavers at Bujold's Retreat have been robbing Skaal sledges. Among their loot is Old Skjald's carved hunting mask, an heirloom three generations old, which their leader means to sell to a Telvanni.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bujolds_retreat.o0.t: Drive the reavers out of Bujold's Retreat
story.skycraft.q.pl_bujolds_retreat.o3.r: His father's face, and his father's. Skjald will weep and pretend it is the wind. You did a thing the Skaal would not do, outlander, and I am not sure whether to thank you or scold you. I will thank you.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bujolds_retreat.o3.t: Return the mask to Yrsa Seal-Singer in the Skaal Village
The reavers won't be raiding sledges any more. And this is Old Skjald's.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bujolds_retreat.outr: Old Skjald wore the mask at the next hunt. The seals, Yrsa says, came closer than they have in years.
story.skycraft.q.pl_bujolds_retreat.pitc: Reavers at Bujold's Retreat took the Skaal's sledges and an old hunting mask that means more to them than gold. The Skaal won't fight for it. Somebody else could.
story.skycraft.q.pl_castle_karstaag_ruin: A frozen hunter's journal speaks of a frost giant sitting on the old throne of Karstaag, holding a shard of the ice crown in its fist.
Enter the ruins of Castle Karstaag
Defeat the giant on the cold throne
Take the shard of the ice crown

So the cold king had children after all. This is not stalhrim, but it is its cousin. I will keep it where it cannot be cut into a Telvanni's toy. Take this for your trouble, and keep your fingers by the fire tonight.
Bring the shard to Aevar Stone-Ear, who knows the ice
This came from the fist of Karstaag's heir.
The cold throne is empty again. The Skaal say that the next giant to sit on it will need a very long memory, and a great deal of patience.
There are giant tracks outside Castle Karstaag, big as a cart. Some say the old king's get has taken his throne. A hunter went in for the crown of ice and never came out.
story.skycraft.q.pl_chillwind_depths.des: The trapper Orla's partner Brannoc chased a fox into Chillwind Depths and was taken by the Falmer. Their masked leader wears his brass compass as a trophy.
The compass hung from Chitin-Mask's neck. Its needle still points north, toward the surface, toward Orla.
Kill the masked Falmer who took Brannoc
story.skycraft.q.pl_chillwind_depths.out: Orla buries the compass by the cave mouth, facing north, and moves her traplines to the far side of the Reach.
story.skycraft.q.pl_chillwind_depths.pit: Orla the trapper's been sitting outside Chillwind Depths for days. Her man went down after a fox and the blind elves got him. She just wants his compass back. Something to bury.
story.skycraft.q.pl_clearpine_pond.desc: A Pinemoon bandit buried his share of a Legion payroll at Clearpine Pond, by the rotten stump on the north shore, a forearm deep.
story.skycraft.q.pl_clearpine_pond.o0.jo: A purse of Legion septims and a gold ring with a little eagle on it. The escort who wore it never came home.
story.skycraft.q.pl_clearpine_pond.o0.te: Dig by the rotten stump on the north shore of Clearpine Pond
story.skycraft.q.pl_clearpine_pond.outro: Skjaldi's share is yours now. The ring with the little eagle might mean something to somebody at Fort Hraggstad.
story.skycraft.q.pl_clearpine_pond.pitch: One of the Pinemoon lot buried something at Clearpine Pond, old Fenric says. North shore, by a stump. Fenric won't touch it. Says it's thieves' money and thieves' luck.
story.skycraft.q.pl_clearpine_pond.title: Skjaldi's Share
story.skycraft.q.pl_crabbers_shanty.desc: The journal of Grisvar, a dead crabber, says his life's savings lie buried under the third trap from his shanty door, the one with the blue rope.
story.skycraft.q.pl_crabbers_shanty.o1.j: The purse was there, an arm deep in the shingle. So was Jarl, the biggest mudcrab I have ever seen. Grisvar was right. He bites.
story.skycraft.q.pl_crabbers_shanty.o1.t: Dig under the trap with the blue rope
story.skycraft.q.pl_crabbers_shanty.outr: Grisvar's purse held a lifetime of crab money. He would probably want it spent on something better than crabs.
story.skycraft.q.pl_crabbers_shanty.pitc: Old Grisvar the crabber never spent a coin. When he died, nobody found a septim. If you're bold enough to wade in among his crabs, the purse is yours.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cragslane_cavern.des: A Khajiit pit-master runs wolf fights and a skooma trade from Cragslane Cavern. Hrongar Shatter-Shield of Windhelm owes the house more than his life is worth.
Clear out the pit's guards and fighting wolves
Put an end to Dro'Marash, the pit-master
I let the old wolf Greyjaw go out the back way. He did not look back. Hrongar's debt marker can go to the fire in Windhelm, or to his sister. Either way it is paid.
Burn the debt book, but keep Hrongar's marker
story.skycraft.q.pl_cragslane_cavern.out: The wolf-pit is cold, and somewhere in the hills a grey wolf is learning to hunt for itself again.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cragslane_cavern.pit: Down at Cragslane Cavern they set wolves on each other for coin and sell moon sugar between bouts. A Shatter-Shield cousin owes them four hundred septims. They'll collect in blood if nobody stops them.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cragwallow_slope.des: Someone is digging up the dead of Kynesgrove and carrying them to Cragwallow Slope. Sidgar the shrine-keeper wants them brought home.
Put Kynesgrove's risen dead back to rest
Venkar had seated the widow Asta at the head of his table. I took the brooch from her shawl so that Kynesgrove would have something to bury.
Asta's brooch. She wore it to every funeral in this village, and now it goes to her own, twice. Kyne keep you. And keep them, this time.
Bring Asta's brooch to Sidgar in Kynesgrove
Your dead won't be troubled again.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cragwallow_slope.out: Sidgar has begun walking the graveyard each night with a lantern of his own.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cragwallow_slope.pit: The graves behind Kynesgrove's shrine have been emptied twice since Hearthfire. Old Sidgar saw lanterns on Cragwallow Slope. He's a priest, not a fighter, and he's asking anyone who is.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cronvangr_cave.desc: A Dunmer vampire, Mistress Hlevala, keeps a larder in Cronvangr Cave. Among her captives is Sigrun of Mixwater, taken at Mara's Eye Pond on the night of her vow.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cronvangr_cave.o0.te: Cut through Hlevala's thralls in Cronvangr Cave
story.skycraft.q.pl_cronvangr_cave.o2.jo: I came too late for Sigrun. She was laid out on a stone table like a guest of honour, with a copper ring still on her finger. She had kept her vow.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cronvangr_cave.outro: Somewhere near the Steamcrag springs, Ottar is still working up his courage. He will want the ring.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cronvangr_cave.pitch: Sigrun of Mixwater went up to Mara's Eye Pond to marry her Ottar, and the vampires of Cronvangr Cave took her mid-vow. Ottar ran. Somebody has to go in after her.
story.skycraft.q.pl_cronvangr_cave.title: Taken Mid-Vow
story.skycraft.q.pl_crystaldrift_cave.de: A Ratway thief named Svari hid a ring from a Goldenglow job under a cracked boulder near Crystaldrift Cave, and never came back for it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_crystaldrift_cave.o0: Under the boulder: an old gold ring in a waxed purse. A frost spider had made a nest on top of the stone. Svari would have hated it.
Dig under the lightning-cracked boulder west of Crystaldrift Cave
story.skycraft.q.pl_crystaldrift_cave.ou: Svari's ring is mine now. The note says not to sell it in Riften. Good advice in general.
story.skycraft.q.pl_crystaldrift_cave.pi: Svari the Quick hid his take near Crystaldrift Cave. Froze his toes off going back for it, the story goes. Probably still there, if you don't mind spiders.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.desc: A deckhand of the Dainty Sload left a confession: the ship carries forty crates of skooma, and the captain's true manifest names the Solitude men who paid for it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.o0.text: Find the true manifest in the captain's sea chest
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.o2.c0.l: Give him everything, names and all.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.o2.c0.r: Then I'll take it over his head, to the Jarl's steward, and I'll probably lose my post for it. Good. A man should lose something for doing right, or it doesn't count.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.o2.c1.l: Tear off the deckhand's name first, then hand it over.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.o2.c1.r: Joric Saltmane. Yes, I see. He'd be the first to hang, wouldn't he, and the last to deserve it. Burn that strip. I never saw it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.o2.repl: Let me see. Forty crates... Varo... and this name. This is my own superior's hand. Gods. What do you want me to do with it?
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.o2.text: Show the manifest to Aulus Carvain in Solitude
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.o2.topi: I have the Dainty Sload's real manifest.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.outro: The Dainty Sload's crates go into the sea under Company eyes, and one or two Solitude merchants find urgent business in Cyrodiil.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.pitch: That pretty ship anchored under the cliffs? She's carrying skooma, or so the gossip goes. The Company would pay well for proof. Proof's in the captain's sea chest, they say.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dainty_sload.title: Sweet Cargo
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.desc: Damphall Mine was abandoned when scalding water broke into the lower galleries and ash spawn climbed out of the steam. The miners' payroll chest was left behind in the overseer's alcove.
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.o0.tex: Clear the ash spawn from the lower galleries
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.o1.tex: Recover the payroll chest from the overseer's alcove
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.o2.rep: Every coin. I'll pay the miners myself, on the docks, where their families can see. The overseer will hear about this too, and not kindly. You have the Guard's thanks.
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.o2.tex: Bring the payroll to Sergeant Mileth Indaram in Raven Rock
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.o2.top: The Damphall payroll. All one hundred and twelve drakes.
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.outro: Eleven families on the Raven Rock docks ate well that week. The mine remains closed, and the steam still rises from it on cold mornings.
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.pitch: Eleven miners from Damphall are owed a month's wages. The payroll's still down in the mine, with the ash spawn. The overseer won't go back for it. Sergeant Indaram would see it fairly paid.
story.skycraft.q.pl_damphall_mine.title: Wages for the Dead Shift
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.desc: Bashnag gro-Larak of Mor Khazgur asked me to find out what happened to his brother Durz in Darkfall Cave.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.o1.tex: Kill the Falmer who took Durz's bow
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.o2.jou: Durz died hidden in a crack in the rock, his tusk-string still around his neck.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.o3.rep: ...Then he hangs by the fire tonight, with our father. You did a thing for an Orc that Orcs do not ask. Mor Khazgur will remember your face.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.o3.tex: Bring the tusk-string to Bashnag in Mor Khazgur
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.offer: You look like a hunter who's lost his quarry.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.outro: Bashnag hung the tusk-string over the longhouse fire and went hunting the next morning.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.pitch: Not my quarry. My brother. Durz went into Darkfall Cave after a wounded bear. The chief says it is my shame to carry. I carry it. But I cannot carry it into that dark alone and come back out.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkfall_cave.title: The Tusk-String
story.skycraft.q.pl_darklight_tower.desc: A hagraven called the Gnarlmother promised a Snow-Shod child to make the Black-Briar debt collectors go away, for a price paid in hair, teeth and song. Her crows have been watching the farm.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darklight_tower.o2.j: I smashed the bottle on the tower stair. The song flew out of it, just for a moment, like a bird. Somewhere south of Riften, a girl will sleep through the night.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darklight_tower.o2.t: Take the bottle with the child's song
story.skycraft.q.pl_darklight_tower.outr: The Gnarlmother is dead and her crows have scattered. The Snow-Shods still owe the Black-Briars forty septims, but a hagraven isn't the one collecting.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darklight_tower.pitc: The Snow-Shod girl's been sleepwalking toward Darklight Tower. Her father's sleeping in the barn with an axe. Somebody ought to visit that tower before she gets there.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkshade.desc: The herbalist Ardwen Leafwright fled Darkshade and left behind his book of alchemical receipts. An ancient spriggan guards the inner pool.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkshade.o1.text: Face the Thornfather at the inner pool
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkshade.o2.journal: The receipt book was lying by the pool, open, as if something had been reading it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkshade.outro: Ardwen's receipts include three new ones, written in a hand that is not his and in an ink that smells of sap.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkshade.pitch: An herbalist ran out of Darkshade with spriggans on his heels and left his receipt book behind. Twenty years of potion-craft in that book. He'll pay, if you can face the thing with the antlers.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkshade.title: Receipts in the Moss
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkwater_pass.desc: A surveyor charting Darkwater Pass for a cart road lost his lodestone to the Falmer, and went back into the dark for it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkwater_pass.o0.te: Search Darkwater Pass for the surveyor
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkwater_pass.o1.jo: Hadvar Iron-Line lay near the Falmer camp with his chain still wound round his arm. The lodestone was on a little shrine of bone.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkwater_pass.outro: The lodestone points north again. Someone at Darkwater Crossing will be glad of it, and sorrier about the man who carried it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkwater_pass.pitch: A surveyor from Darkwater Crossing went into the pass with a fancy lodestone and came out without it. Then went back in. He's not come out a second time.
story.skycraft.q.pl_darkwater_pass.title: The Lost Lodestone
story.skycraft.q.pl_deepwood_redoubt.des: A woodcutter from Dragon Bridge left a letter at Deepwood Redoubt. The Forsworn took his son Toki, and a hagraven named Ungrid has him.
The cage was empty but for the hawk whistle. Small footprints led out through a gap cut in the briars. Toki may have run.
story.skycraft.q.pl_deepwood_redoubt.out: Horgeir waits at the mill in Dragon Bridge. The whistle, and the footprints, will give him a reason to keep waiting.
story.skycraft.q.pl_deepwood_redoubt.pit: A woodcutter from Dragon Bridge broke his arm trying to get into Deepwood Redoubt after his boy. The crones have the child. Somebody with a stronger arm should try.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dragon_bridge_overlo: Bandits at Dragon Bridge Overlook stole the Karthwasten payroll, and with it the ledger the miners need to prove what the Silver-Bloods owe them.
The payroll chest was half empty, but the ledger was wrapped in oilcloth at the bottom.
Every ingot, every septim, every lie the factor told us. With this we can go to Understone Keep and make them listen. Or at least make them pretend to.
Return the ledger to Bergljot in Karthwasten
The miners of Karthwasten copied the ledger three times and hid each copy in a different house.

Hrodvar Toll-Taker's lot took the Karthwasten payroll. Coin's gone, most like, but the miners' ledger is worth more to them than the silver. Bergljot in Karthwasten would kiss whoever brought it home.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dragon_mound_evergre: Calvus Aterius, an Imperial antiquarian staying in Falkreath, is studying the opened dragon mounds of the hold. His assistant Ennis Hollowgate disappeared while surveying the mound above Bilegulch Mine.
Examine the opened mound near Evergreen Grove
Follow Ennis's trail to the mound north of Sunderstone Gorge
Ennis's satchel was hidden in the rocks by the pit. Of Ennis there is no sign but a set of tracks heading toward the orc mine, and an empty honey jar.
Recover Ennis's satchel from the Bilegulch mound

The drawings! Splendid, splendid. And Ennis went to the orcs, did he? With honey? Then he is either their guest or their dinner, and either way he has finished the survey. Three mounds, one season, all opened from below. Something is waking them, friend. I must write to the Imperial Library at once.
Bring Ennis's satchel to Calvus in Falkreath
Ennis's satchel. His tracks led toward Bilegulch Mine.
Some days later, Ennis Hollowgate walks into Falkreath smelling strongly of Orc mead, with a story about how honey is, in fact, a universal language.

Precisely! The dragon mounds of this hold have opened, from the inside, all in one season. I sent my assistant Ennis to survey the one above Bilegulch Mine, and he has not returned. Retrace his steps for me: the mound by Evergreen Grove, then Sunderstone, then Bilegulch. Bring back his satchel, and if possible, Ennis.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dragon_mound_frokis_: Hrelga Dawnmoor, a keeper of the Temple of Mara, is counting the dragon mounds of the Rift. One near Froki's Shack is open. She wants to know about the other two.
The cap-stone at Autumnshade is split. The ground hums.
Look at the dragon mound by Autumnshade Clearing
Below Lost Tongue the ground is burned in a ring and the mound smokes without fire. Two draugr were standing guard on it, facing outward.
Look at the dragon mound below Lost Tongue Overlook
Guards. On a grave. Waiting for someone to come home. ...Thank you. I'll write to the Jarl, and to Whiterun, and I'll light every candle we have. It isn't much. It's what I've got.
Tell Hrelga Dawnmoor what you saw
One cracked and humming, one burnt and smoking, and draugr standing guard.
Three dragon mounds in the Rift: one open, one cracked, one smoking. Hrelga is writing letters, and lighting candles.
The candle-keeper at the Temple of Mara is counting dragon mounds, of all things. She's paying anyone brave enough to go and look at them.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dragon_mound_harmugs: A cult calling itself the Returning Wing chants over the dragon burial mound north of Harmugstahl, hoping to wake the dragon inside with blood.
Go to the dragon mound north of Harmugstahl
The chanting stopped, and the mound settled. Whatever sleeps beneath it sleeps on, for now.
Put down the dead the chanting stirred
The Returning Wing's sermons were left to rot in the rain. The mound north of Harmugstahl is quiet.
Robed lunatics are chanting at the dragon mound north of Harmugstahl. They took a shepherd from Karthwasten last week. If they wake what's in there, we'll all be goats.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dragon_mound_pale_im: The dragon mound south of the Pale Imperial Camp steams in the frost, and the Legion picket has seen ancient warriors standing on it at night.
The warden fell, and the steam over the mound thinned and died. Whatever lies beneath sleeps on, for now.
Decurion Tellus puts in a report. Quartermaster Ostorian files it under 'Do not mention to the Legate'.
The Legion's frightened of an old grave south of their coast camp. Warriors standing on it at night, steam coming off it like breath. Somebody should look before something climbs out.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dragontooth_crater.d: A dragon nests in Dragontooth Crater and raids the herds of Karthwasten. The hunter Ingrith wounded it under the jaw before it burned her.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dragontooth_crater.o: Climb to the rim of Dragontooth Crater
An old arrow was still lodged under the dragon's jaw. Ingrith had not missed.
Karthwasten's goats graze to the crater's rim again. The miners call it Ingrith's Field now.
story.skycraft.q.pl_dragontooth_crater.p: There's a dragon in Dragontooth Crater stealing goats and frightening children. Ingrith Sure-Shot got an arrow into it before it cooked her bow arm. Somebody needs to finish what she started.
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.desc: Arcadia of Whiterun lent a Dunmer mage named Drelas her best alembic and never got it back. Drelas answers letters with fire.
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.o1.te: Deal with Drelas and her atronach
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.o2.jo: The alembic was on Drelas' workbench, still warm from the summoning salts.
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.o2.te: Find Arcadia's alembic in the cottage
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.o3.re: Not a crack in it! Sooty, but whole. I would have settled for an apology, you know. This is better.
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.o3.te: Return the alembic to Arcadia in Whiterun
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.outro: Arcadia's alembic is back on her shelf. She has stopped lending things to anyone who lives outside the walls.
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.pitch: Arcadia lent the witch out west a fancy alembic and the witch won't give it back. Arcadia says she'll pay anyone who fetches it. Mind the fire spirit.
story.skycraft.q.pl_drelas_cottage.title: Borrowed Glass
story.skycraft.q.pl_eldersblood_peak.des: A grey, scarred dragon has risen from the old burial mound south of Morthal and made its perch on Eldersblood Peak. It takes a cow a week from the herders of Hjaalmarch, and soon it will want more.
The storm-wing has fallen on its own perch. The marsh clans' old price is paid at last, in iron, as the stones asked.
story.skycraft.q.pl_eldersblood_peak.out: Grima's sons carve a new line on the summit ring. The herders of Hjaalmarch drive their cattle up to the high pastures again.
story.skycraft.q.pl_eldersblood_peak.pit: The storm-wing's back on Eldersblood Peak, like in the old stories. Grima's lost eleven head and her boys are sharpening spears. Someone with more than a spear needs to go up there before they do.
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.desc: Thieves have stolen the great Yokudan lens of Elinhir's Serpent Tower and carried it to the shrine of Nocturnal south of the city. Magister Hadiya Sel-Nur will pay handsomely for its return.
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.o0.text: Go to the shrine of Nocturnal south of Elinhir
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.o1.journal: Zahra Quickhand is dead. She swore the lens showed the paths between the stars. Perhaps it does.
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.o1.text: Deal with Zahra Quickhand and the Dusk Crew
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.o2.journal: The lens lay on the shrine, wrapped in black velvet and turned to the sky. When I lifted it I saw, for a heartbeat, a pale road running between the stars.
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.o2.text: Recover the great lens of the Serpent Tower
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.outro: The great lens goes back into the Serpent Tower, and Magister Hadiya Sel-Nur keeps her promise not to complain, for very nearly a whole season.
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.pitch: The mages of Elinhir have lost their great glass. Thieves took it to the Nocturnal shrine south of town, they say. The Magister's paying well, and she's promised to stop complaining. That alone's worth the walk.
story.skycraft.q.pl_elinhir.title: The Serpent's Lens
story.skycraft.q.pl_embershard_mine.desc: The foreman of Embershard Mine asks that someone recover the miners' paychest from the bandit Skarn Two-Pick.
story.skycraft.q.pl_embershard_mine.o1.t: Clear the bandits from the mine
story.skycraft.q.pl_embershard_mine.o3.j: The paychest is still sealed. Skarn kept his word about Fredas, at least.
story.skycraft.q.pl_embershard_mine.outr: The miners of Embershard drift back to their shafts, and the foreman sends you a share and a promise of cheap ore.
story.skycraft.q.pl_embershard_mine.pitc: Bandits under Skarn Two-Pick ran the Embershard miners off the day after payday. Two hundred and forty septims of honest wages, sitting in a bandit's room. The miners will share it with whoever gets it back.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fahlbtharz.desc: A Company prospector found a Dwemer pressure regulator at the heart of Fahlbtharz, guarded by a steam centurion the regulator itself keeps awake.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fahlbtharz.o0.text: Enter the steam halls of Fahlbtharz
story.skycraft.q.pl_fahlbtharz.o1.text: Destroy the centurion that guards the regulator
story.skycraft.q.pl_fahlbtharz.o2.journa: The pipes went quiet the moment the regulator came loose. After four thousand years, Fahlbtharz has finally stopped breathing.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fahlbtharz.outro: Decimus Vello paid his share and bought out his Company contract. Ulvo Nerano, hearing of it, has written him nine letters.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fahlbtharz.pitch: There's a Company prospector, Decimus Vello, telling anyone at the Retching Netch about a brass heart in Fahlbtharz worth a fortune. He needs a fighter. The heart's got a guard.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fahlbtharz.title: The Brass Heart
story.skycraft.q.pl_faldars_tooth.desc: The Ashwood Knives have robbed the western road from their den at Faldar's Tooth. The Riften guard has posted a bounty on their chief, Ottar Ashwood, and declined to collect it themselves.
story.skycraft.q.pl_faldars_tooth.o0.tex: Find the Ashwood Knives at Faldar's Tooth
story.skycraft.q.pl_faldars_tooth.o1.jou: Ottar Ashwood laughed right up to the end. It was not a long laugh.
story.skycraft.q.pl_faldars_tooth.o2.jou: In the chief's chest, beside the knife, was a small pair of boots. A mill boy's, by the size.
story.skycraft.q.pl_faldars_tooth.o2.tex: Take Ottar's bone-handled knife as proof
story.skycraft.q.pl_faldars_tooth.outro: The Ashwood Knives are broken and the western road is open. The boy at Heartwood Mill will get his boots back.
story.skycraft.q.pl_faldars_tooth.pitch: The guard's offering two hundred for Ottar Ashwood. They won't go up to Faldar's Tooth themselves, mind. Busy, they say. Busy counting Briar coin.
story.skycraft.q.pl_faldars_tooth.title: Knives in the Birches
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.desc: Ingrid, the gravedigger of Falkreath, says someone is stealing the dead from the town graveyard. Their tracks lead to the Roadside Ruins northwest of town.
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.o0.text: Follow the grave robber's trail to the Roadside Ruins
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.o1.journal: The necromancer Corvus is dead. His journal speaks of a Mistress at a place called Southfringe Sanctum.
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.o3.reply: A necromancer. Of course. I'll put the ring back on Hrofar's hand myself, once I've found the rest of Hrofar. If there's a Mistress behind him, though... this isn't over, is it?
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.o3.text: Bring the ring to Ingrid in Falkreath
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.o3.topic: The grave robber is dead. Here is Hrofar's ring.
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.offer: You look like you haven't slept in days.
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.outro: Ingrid sleeps with her shovel across her knees still, but now she sleeps.
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.pitch: Three graves opened since Hearthfire, and two of them empty. The boot prints go northwest, up the old road to the Roadside Ruins. I've a shovel and a grudge, but you've a sword. Find who's taking them. And Hrofar's ring, if you can. His wife wants it back.
story.skycraft.q.pl_falkreath.title: Arkay's Short Count
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.desc: Brother Alvi of the Temple of Kynareth went to Fellglow Keep, lured by necromancers who promised to raise his dead mother. Sister Hildrun wants him found.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.o0.tex: Fight through the necromancers of Fellglow Keep
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.o1.jou: The necromancers made Alvi one of their thralls. I put him to rest and took the hawk amulet from his neck.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.o1.tex: Find Brother Alvi in the lower cells
Tell her the truth: they made him a thrall, and I had to put him down.
Kynareth forgive them, because I cannot. Thank you for not sparing me. I would rather grieve the truth than a kind story.
Tell her he died fighting them, trying to escape.
Fighting. Yes. That was Alvi, at the end. He was always braver than he knew. Thank you. I will tell the others he came back to us.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.o2.rep: Your face tells me before your words do. What happened to him?
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.o2.tex: Tell Sister Hildrun what became of Alvi
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.outro: Alvi's hawk amulet hangs beneath the Gildergreen now, where Sister Hildrun prays for him each morning.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.pitch: Brother Alvi, one of our acolytes. His mother died this spring and the grief ate him. Then mages from Fellglow Keep came promising to bring the dead back, and he went with them. Please, find him. Bring him home, or bring me the truth.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fellglow_keep.title: The Acolyte of Fellglow
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.desc: Verulus Agrippa's apprentice Junia went into the flooded barrow of Folgunthur to copy its lineage tablet and has not returned.
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.o0.text: Enter Folgunthur and search for Junia
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.o1.text: Lay the drowned warden to rest
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.o2.journa: Junia died in her alcove with the rubbing rolled tight against her chest, dry, every name complete.
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.o2.text: Recover Junia's rubbing of the lineage tablet
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.o3.reply: ...Of course she finished it. She was always going to finish it. She wrote that I was wrong? Then I was wrong. It will be published under her name. First author. No footnote.
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.o3.text: Bring the rubbing to Verulus in Solitude
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.o3.topic: Junia didn't make it. But she finished the rubbing.
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.outro: The Folgunthur Lineage, by Junia Fulvia, is read aloud at the Bards College. Verulus sits at the back and does not correct a single word.
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.pitch: Worried? I am never worried; I am occasionally concerned. My apprentice Junia went down into Folgunthur to copy the lineage tablet and was due back on Turdas. It is now the following Turdas. If you are going south, through the marsh... I would take it as a professional courtesy. A personal one, also. Footnote it as you like.
story.skycraft.q.pl_folgunthur.title: The Lineage of Folgunthur
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.desc: A First Era siege captain left the High Priest's door-signet in the lower halls of Forelhost, with his men's names cut beside it. Hrelga Dawnmoor of the Temple of Mara wants it, so their names can be read at the vigil.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.o1.journal: The signet lay on a ledge in the lower hall. Eleven names were cut beside it, and a twelfth, half-finished.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.o1.text: Find the door-signet in the lower hall
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.o2.reply: Unfinished? Then he cut his own last, and never got to the end of it. We'll read twelve names at the vigil. I'll cut his for him on the temple wall.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.o2.text: Bring the signet to Hrelga Dawnmoor in Riften
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.o2.topic: Captain Hroald's signet. His men's names were beside it. Eleven, and one unfinished.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.outro: Twelve names will be read at the Hearthfire vigil in Riften. The last of them, Hroald, was a captain who did not run.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.pitch: The keeper at the Temple of Mara wants something brought back from Forelhost, an old captain's ring. Forelhost, mind. The Cult's old fortress. Bring a big sword and a bigger heart.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forelhost.title: The Siege Captain's Signet
story.skycraft.q.pl_forsaken_cave.desc: Kolbeinn Rime-Hand deserted the Pale Stormcloak camp with the company banner and fled into Forsaken Cave rather than march against his cousin.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forsaken_cave.o0.tex: Find the banner in Forsaken Cave
story.skycraft.q.pl_forsaken_cave.o1.jou: Kolbeinn was dead before you reached him, curled up behind the throne. He had kept the banner off the floor.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forsaken_cave.o1.tex: Defeat the crowned draugr on the throne
story.skycraft.q.pl_forsaken_cave.o2.tex: Return the banner to the Pale Stormcloak Camp
story.skycraft.q.pl_forsaken_cave.outro: Sergeant Gunnvor reads Kolbeinn's journal and burns it. 'He died guarding the colours,' she tells the company. Nobody contradicts her.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forsaken_cave.pitch: A Stormcloak boy ran into Forsaken Cave with his company's banner. The sergeant wants the banner back. She's quieter about wanting the boy.
story.skycraft.q.pl_forsaken_cave.title: The Bear-and-Axe Banner
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_amol.desc: Ulfgar the Unwashed and the Lost Knife gang have taken the abandoned Stormcloak fort at Fort Amol. The garrison's old bear standard is his blanket.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_amol.o0.text: Clear the Lost Knives out of Fort Amol
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_amol.o2.journal: The standard was where Ulfgar's letter said it would be: on his bed. It will need washing before anyone in Windhelm sees it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_amol.o2.text: Recover the Bear Standard of Fort Amol
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_amol.outro: Fort Amol stands empty again, its old banner folded, waiting for a garrison or a war.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_amol.pitch: Ulfric emptied Fort Amol to hold Windhelm, and the Lost Knife gang moved in before the gate had stopped swinging. They say their chief sleeps under the fort's own standard.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_amol.title: Lords by Morning Star
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_dunstad.desc: Courier Anvari left Fort Dunstad with troop dispositions for the Pale and was dragged into Duskglow Crevice by the Falmer. The commander needs the case back.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_dunstad.o0.jour: Anvari kept his promise. The case was under him, still sealed.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_dunstad.o0.text: Recover the dispatch case from Duskglow Crevice
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_dunstad.o1.text: Return the dispatches to Fort Dunstad
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_dunstad.outro: Commander Rufio sends Anvari's last letter on to his sister in Bruma. Felix pays the nine septims, too, under protest.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_dunstad.pitch: Fort Dunstad lost a courier to the Falmer at Duskglow. He was carrying something the Legion badly wants back. Commander Rufio's posted a reward.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_dunstad.title: The Lost Dispatches
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_fellhammer.desc: Rolff Thin-Fingers, a fence at Fort Fellhammer, bought a bronze bell hauled up from the drowned temple of old Winterhold. Ysolde Frost-Hand has been searching for it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_fellhammer.o0.t: Deal with Rolff Thin-Fingers and his guards
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_fellhammer.o1.t: Find the bell of the drowned temple
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_fellhammer.o2.r: Three strokes, slow, the way they rang it for the dead. I'll hang it on the cliff where the temple stood. Let the sea hear it ring from this side for once.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_fellhammer.o2.t: Bring the bell to Ysolde Frost-Hand in Winterhold
The bell from the drowned temple.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_fellhammer.outr: On the lowest tide of Evening Star, Ysolde rings the bell three times. Some swear they hear an answer from beneath the water.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_fellhammer.pitc: There's a fence at Fort Fellhammer selling a bell they say came up from the drowned temple. Ysolde Frost-Hand's been asking every trader in the hold about it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.desc: Aulus Vettrius's brother Gaius went into Fort Frostmoth to recover the cohort standard of their great-grandfather's legion. The fort's dead still stand to at their posts, and Gaius has not returned.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.o0.te: Lay the restless legionaries of Fort Frostmoth to rest
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.o1.jo: Gaius Vettrius lay by the inner hall, dead of his wounds, his hand still reaching for the standard.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.o1.te: Relieve the officer's shade of his command
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.o2.te: Take the cohort standard from the inner hall
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.o3.re: ...He got further than anyone in two hundred years. That's a Vettrius for you. I'll hang the standard over my door, and I'll take the next ship to bring Gaius home. The cohort's dismissed. They've earned it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.o3.te: Bring the standard to Aulus Vettrius in Raven Rock
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.o3.to: The standard. And I'm sorry: Gaius didn't make it out.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.offer: You look like a man with a weight on him.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.outro: Aulus has hung the cohort's standard over his door in Raven Rock. The Redoran Guard pretend not to see it. Some of them salute it anyway.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.pitch: My brother Gaius went into Fort Frostmoth to bring our great-grandfather's cohort standard home. The dead there are still standing to, two hundred years after the mountain burst. Gaius hasn't come back. Bring the standard, and if you can, give those poor soldiers their orders to stand down.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_frostmoth.title: Stand Down
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.desc: The bandits at Fort Greenwall charge every cart a toll except the Black-Briars'. Their chief, Brannoc Tollhand, keeps a book of every coin. Somebody in Riften would very much like it to burn.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.o0.jo: Brannoc Tollhand died with his strongbox key around his neck.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.o0.te: Break the Greenwall toll gang and its chief
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.o1.te: Take the toll book from Brannoc's strongbox
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.o2.c0: Put it before the Jarl. Let Riften see who it pays.
Then I'll read it aloud in court myself, and see who goes pale. Maven will know it was us. Watch your back on the canal.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.o2.c1: Burn it. Nobody in this hold will act on it anyway.
Wise, maybe. Cowardly, maybe. Both, probably. I'll fetch a candle. And I'll remember that the road is quieter now, at least.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.o2.re: Shor's bones. Every Briar wagon, every bribe, every guard who looked away. What do you want done with it?
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.o2.te: Decide what becomes of the toll book
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.outro: Brannoc Tollhand will charge no more tolls on the Riften road. What became of his book is between me, a clerk named Ingrith and, sooner or later, Maven Black-Briar.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.pitch: You want to know who really runs the Riften road? Brannoc Tollhand at Fort Greenwall keeps a book. Get the book and you'll know. Then you'll wish you didn't.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greenwall.title: The Toll Book
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greymoor.desc: The last paymaster of Fort Greymoor buried the garrison's back pay outside the walls, thirty paces from the south-west tower, under a stone marked with the Legion eagle. He never returned for it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greymoor.o0.jou: The eagle stone was half sunk in the turf. Beneath it lay the pay chest, rusted but whole, and inside it the garrison's silver ring of service.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greymoor.o0.tex: Dig under the eagle stone south-west of the fort
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greymoor.outro: Optio Gratian Sabe wanted the pay to go to whoever served the Empire best. I suppose I'll have to decide whether that's me.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greymoor.pitch: Old soldiers swear the Legion buried two months' pay outside Fort Greymoor when they pulled out. Under a stone with the eagle on it, south-west of the fort. Mind the Silver Hand on the walls.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_greymoor.title: The Buried Pay
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_kastav.desc: Grelka Iron-Jaw, the bandit chief of Fort Kastav, is bleeding Anga's Mill dry with her timber tribute. Hallvard at the mill would pay to see it stopped.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_kastav.o1.journ: Grelka is dead. The self-styled Lady of Kastav will collect no more tolls.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_kastav.o1.text: Put an end to Grelka Iron-Jaw
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_kastav.o2.reply: No more tribute? Then this winter we patch our own roofs first. Here, it's not much, but it's honest timber money.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_kastav.o2.topic: Grelka won't be collecting any more planks.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_kastav.outro: Anga's Mill sends its timber to Windhelm again, and for once the planks stay on the right side of the road.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_kastav.pitch: The Kastav bandits take half of what Anga's Mill cuts. Hallvard says he'd give his saw to see Grelka gone. Well, not his saw. But something.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_kastav.title: Twenty Planks a Week
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.desc: Captain Ulfgar Broadshield and his deserters hold Fort Neugrad and the Legion's payroll coffer, which lies under the third flagstone from the cellar stair.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.o2.jour: Broadshield's key opened the coffer under the third flagstone. The Legion's eight hundred septims are all there.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.o3.c0.l: Return it to the Legion through the hold.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.o3.c0.r: Honest. I'll see it goes west to the camp under guard, and I'll see your name goes with it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.o3.c1.l: I'm keeping it. They abandoned it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.o3.c1.r: I didn't hear that. I didn't see the coffer. Get it out of my sight before I remember I'm a bailiff.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.o3.repl: Eight hundred septims of Legion silver. The Legion will want it back. The Stormcloaks would find it very useful. And you, I imagine, could find a use for it too.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.o3.text: Decide what to do with the payroll
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.o3.topi: I've recovered the Legion's payroll from Fort Neugrad.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.outro: A prisoner named Pell walks out of Fort Neugrad's cells into daylight for the first time in weeks, blinking.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.pitch: When the Legion left Fort Neugrad, Captain Broadshield stayed behind with the garrison's payroll. Eight hundred septims. He calls his men the Free Company now. I call them thieves with good boots.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_neugrad.title: The Payroll Never Arrived
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.desc: Thorvar Mist-Eye, steward of Highmoon Hall, sent three guards to investigate Fort Snowhawk. None returned.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.o0.tex: Put down the marsh dead in Fort Snowhawk
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.o1.jou: Vigdis is dead. Her journal names all three guards. Hallgerd's charcoal note was hidden in the cage.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.o2.rep: ...Hallgerd wrote that it wasn't my fault. That's like her. I'll read it to her mother myself. And then I'll burn this book, and then I'll have a drink, and then I'll be steward again.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.o2.tex: Bring Vigdis's journal to Thorvar in Morthal
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.o2.top: Your patrol is dead. Here's the one who did it, in her own words.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.offer: Has something happened to your patrol?
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.outro: Three pyres burn outside Morthal's walls. Jarl Idgrod stands at the window of Highmoon Hall the whole night, watching them.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.pitch: Three of the Jarl's guards went to look at the smoke over Fort Snowhawk. Sten, Ofrid and Hallgerd. Hallgerd's mother asks me every morning. I sent them, so it's mine to answer. Find them. If the worst has happened, find who did it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_snowhawk.title: The Missing Patrol
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_sungard.desc: Vatrius Hollow, a Legion deserter, holds Fort Sungard with a band of turncoats, taxing the road in the Emperor's name. As long as the cohort's eagle standard hangs in his hall, his men believe they are still soldiers.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_sungard.o1.text: Break the deserters on the walls
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_sungard.o3.jour: The eagle standard came off its hooks easily. Without it, Fort Sungard is just an empty fort full of tired men.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_sungard.outro: The road past Fort Sungard is free again. Somewhere in the Legion's records, the Fourth Cohort's eagle is still listed as lost.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_sungard.pitch: Fort Sungard's 'garrison' charged my brother thirty septims to use his own road. They're deserters flying a Legion flag. Take the flag away and I reckon they'll stop pretending.
story.skycraft.q.pl_fort_sungard.title: A Garrison of None
story.skycraft.q.pl_four_skull_lookout.d: Sweet-Tongue Ottar sold fake treasure maps to Four Skull Lookout. His own notes admit the story behind them might be true: a Legion pay chest buried beneath the skull facing west.
story.skycraft.q.pl_four_skull_lookout.o: Under the west skull lay a Legion pay chest from 4E 176, its officer's sword still wrapped in oiled leather. The lie was true all along.
Dig beneath the skull that faces the sunset
Somewhere in Bruma, a paymaster's widow will never know the chest was found. The Emperor will never know either.
story.skycraft.q.pl_four_skull_lookout.p: Everybody laughs at Ottar's maps. But nobody I know ever dug under the west skull at Four Skull Lookout. Everybody gave up before then.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frossel.desc: Brenna Ice-Mead of Thirsk Mead Hall wants the hall's heirloom spear back from Kruk Gnaw-Tooth, the riekling chief of Frossel. Her hunter Gunnar advises going at dusk, and going loud.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frossel.o0.text: Find the riekling den at Frossel
story.skycraft.q.pl_frossel.o3.reply: Then carve the name on the beam, and somebody fetch the good mead. The spear is yours, as I swore. Bring it to the hall on feast days, or I'll come and get it myself.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frossel.o3.text: Tell Brenna Ice-Mead the spear is won
story.skycraft.q.pl_frossel.o3.topic: Kruk Gnaw-Tooth is dead, and the Spear of Thirsk is free.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frossel.outro: Your name is cut into the beam of Thirsk Mead Hall below the chieftains'. The rieklings of Frossel, Brenna says, have started telling a story about you too.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frossel.pitch: The riekling chief Kruk Gnaw-Tooth carried it off to Frossel when his folk held our hall. We took the hall back with axes. The spear's still in his fists. Go at dusk, go loud, and bring it home. Swear to bring it to the hall on feast days, and you can keep it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frossel.title: The Spear of Thirsk
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostflow_lighthouse: The keeper of Frostflow Lighthouse followed something that stole his lens down into the tunnels beneath the tower. The light has been dark for nine nights.
Clear the tunnels beneath the lighthouse
The Falmer had set the lens up in their den like an idol. Keeper Eirik's axe lay beside it.
The Frostflow light burns again over the Sea of Ghosts.
Set the lens back in the lamp
Captain Hjolfrid's ship passes the point safely that night. She does not write a thank-you letter. She does not burn your furniture either.
Frostflow Lighthouse has gone dark and the keeper's gone missing. A ship nearly broke on the point last week. Somebody needs to get that lamp burning.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmere_crypt.desc: Grave-robbers in Frostmere Crypt stole a wedding band from the fresh grave of Gerdir, wife of Sigvald. Their chief, Kjeld the Gravewolf, refuses to sell it back.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmere_crypt.o2.j: Under the cairn lay forty septims and a note: 'For whoever is kinder than the last.' You leave the ring and take the coin.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmere_crypt.o2.t: Leave the ring at the cairn on the crypt road for Sigvald
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmere_crypt.outr: Gerdir's grave is closed again. Sigvald wears her ring on a cord around his neck.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmere_crypt.pitc: The robbers in Frostmere Crypt took old Sigvald's dead wife's ring right off her finger. He's been leaving them notes. They've been laughing.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.desc: Sigvar, the hunter of the Abandoned Lodge, followed a white wolf to Frostmoon Crag and joined the pack. He wears his wife Helga's ring on a thong around his throat. She is still waiting for him in Raven Rock.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.o0.te: Find the pack at Frostmoon Crag
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.o1.te: Face the pack's leader, the Grey Brother
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.o2.jo: The Grey Brother wore a silver ring on a chewed thong. Inside it is engraved: To S., from H., for every Loredas.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.o2.te: Take the ring from the Grey Brother's throat
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.o3.re: He kept it. All that time, whatever he was, he kept it. ...Then I can stop climbing that hill. Thank you. I think. Leave me a while.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.o3.te: Bring the ring to Helga in Raven Rock
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.outro: Helga no longer goes to the lodge on Loredas. She goes to the shrine instead, and lights a candle, and comes home before dark.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.pitch: The hunter from the Abandoned Lodge went chasing a white wolf to Frostmoon Crag. His wife Helga goes up to the lodge every Loredas. Somebody should find out what became of him, for her sake.
story.skycraft.q.pl_frostmoon_crag.title: Every Loredas
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.desc: Werewolf hunters dragged the sawyer Ulmir from Mixwater Mill to the old fort at Gallows Rock. His brother Torvar wants him freed.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o0.text: Break the hunters' hold on Gallows Rock
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o1.jour: The chains were already broken when I reached the cell. The thing inside wore a man's iron ring on one claw. Ulmir's confession lay on the floor in charcoal.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o1.text: Face what waits in the chains
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o2.c0.l: Tell him Ulmir was a werewolf, and show him the confession.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o2.c0.r: Two winters. Two winters of 'deer'. ...He washed his hands in the river every morning and I thought he was just tidy. Give me the ring. I'll bury it under the saw-pit, where he worked. In the daylight.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o2.c1.l: Tell him the hunters killed Ulmir before you arrived.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o2.c1.r: Then I'll see every one of them in the ground. ...You've done that already, haven't you? Good. Give me the ring. He was a good man. Whatever they said, he was a good man.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o2.repl: You've his ring. You wouldn't have his ring if... Tell me straight. I can take it straight.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.o2.text: Tell Torvar at Mixwater Mill what you found
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.outro: Torvar has started sleeping with a lamp lit.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.pitch: Torvar at Mixwater Mill has been begging anyone with a blade to go to Gallows Rock. Hunters took his brother in chains. Torvar swears he's innocent. Torvar would.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gallows_rock.title: The Beast of Mixwater
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.desc: Eydis Long-Net's husband Arne rowed a scholar to Geirmund's Hall and never came back. She asks for the soapstone net-weight he wore.
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.o0.te: Cross Lake Geir to Geirmund's Hall
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.o1.jo: Arne and the College scholar lay together near the flooded stair. She had finished her chapter. He had his hand on her shoulder.
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.o2.re: That's him. That's exactly him. He never could leave anyone in the dark. Thank you. I can stop standing on the dock now.
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.o2.te: Bring the net-weight to Eydis in Ivarstead
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.o2.to: Arne didn't leave her alone in there. He stayed with the scholar to the end.
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.outro: Eydis has stopped waiting on the dock. She wears the soapstone fish around her own neck now.
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.pitch: My husband Arne. He rowed a College woman out to the island in Lake Geir and the lake gave back the boat, not him. He wore a soapstone fish I carved. If you're going out there, bring it home to me.
story.skycraft.q.pl_geirmunds_hall.title: What the Lake Kept
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.desc: Smugglers have seized the Glacial Cave to cut stalhrim without the Skaal's words, and taken the cutting pick from Aevar Stone-Ear's apprentice. The ice has woken something cold in answer.
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.o0.text: Drive the stalhrim smugglers out of the Glacial Cave
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.o1.jour: Hjalmar, the apprentice, is free and on his way home. He told me the smugglers never learned the words.
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.o2.repl: Good. Good. The ice will settle now that the greedy ones are gone. You have done the All-Maker a kindness, which is rarer than you would think.
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.o2.text: Return the pick to Aevar Stone-Ear in the Skaal Village
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.o2.topi: Your apprentice is free, and here is your pick.
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.outro: Aevar has gone to the Glacial Cave to say the words over the broken slabs. He says the ice will forgive the cuts in time. He did not say whether it would forgive the cutters.
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.pitch: Aevar Stone-Ear's apprentice went to the Glacial Cave and found smugglers hacking at the stalhrim. They took the pick his master gave him. Aevar wants it back, and wants the cutting stopped.
story.skycraft.q.pl_glacial_cave.title: The Ice Is Crying
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.desc: Mogdurz of Narzulbur wants vengeance for her husband Dushgar, lost in the east drift of Gloombound Mine where the miners broke into something old and blind.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.o0.t: Clear the east drift of Gloombound Mine
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.o1.t: Kill the creature that took Dushgar
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.o2.j: Dushgar went down fighting; there were three dead Falmer under him. His clan ring was still on his fist.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.o3.r: Of course he did. Malacath heard me, then, and sent you. ...Take this. Ebony from the drift he opened. He'd want it in an outsider's hand, if the outsider earned it. You earned it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.o3.t: Bring Dushgar's ring to Mogdurz in Narzulbur
Dushgar died with his axe in his hand.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.offe: You look like you're carrying a grudge.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.outr: The east drift of Gloombound Mine is open again. The miners leave a cup of mead at the crack for Dushgar.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloombound_mine.pitc: My husband Dushgar went down Gloombound's east drift to prove he wasn't afraid. He was right: he wasn't. Something down there ate him anyway. Bring me what's left, and the head of what did it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloomreach.desc: The spore-gatherer Sinnoc went into Gloomreach to harvest glowing fungus for an alchemist in Markarth and never came out. His full satchel is hidden behind the second falls.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloomreach.o1.text: Find Sinnoc's satchel behind the second falls
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloomreach.o2.journa: The Gardener wore a cord of teeth and one Nord ring. Sinnoc's, I think. The fungus beds will go untended now.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloomreach.outro: The glowing caps fetch a fine price in Markarth. Sinnoc's debt to his alchemist is paid, as he wanted.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloomreach.pitch: Fellow called Sinnoc went into Gloomreach for glowing mushrooms. Took a Markarth alchemist's money in advance and didn't come back. Honest sort, for a mushroom man. His satchel's still down there somewhere.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gloomreach.title: The Gardener's Soil
story.skycraft.q.pl_graywinter_watch.des: A troll in Graywinter Watch has been taking hounds, hunters and even a giant's mammoth calf. The hunter Ulfgar says the Jarl's bounty of 100 septims still stands.
The troll is dead. Its den was littered with arrows it had pulled out of itself.
Kill the troll of Graywinter Watch
Recover Ulfgar's bow from the troll's den
story.skycraft.q.pl_graywinter_watch.out: The bounty on the Graywinter troll has been paid. Ulfgar says he'll carve the troll's tally into his bow.
story.skycraft.q.pl_graywinter_watch.pit: There's a troll in Graywinter Watch, east of the river. The Jarl put a bounty on it and the hunters can't collect. Bring fire. Lots of fire.
story.skycraft.q.pl_greenspring_hollow.d: A hunter's journal tells of the spriggan that keeps Greenspring Hollow, and the poachers whose greed has turned it wild. The hunter says it is the men who need killing, not the spriggan.
story.skycraft.q.pl_greenspring_hollow.o: With the poachers gone, the trees of the hollow seemed to breathe out. Something watched me leave and did not follow.
The keeper of Greenspring Hollow has the bargain back: one deer, a word to Kynareth, and no more.
story.skycraft.q.pl_greenspring_hollow.p: Poachers have camped in Greenspring Hollow, leaving deer to rot for the pelts. The hollow's keeper is angry, and the trees close the paths behind you. Drive the poachers out and maybe it'll calm.
story.skycraft.q.pl_greywater_grotto.des: The herb-wife Ragnhild hid her satchel of white cap in Greywater Grotto before a great frostbite spider caught her. The mushrooms are meant for Brynja's sick son at Half-Moon Mill.
Find Ragnhild's satchel in the dry cleft
White cap. Boiled in milk, three days. She told me that a dozen times. Gods keep her. I'll put the pot on now. And I'll pay for her burial; she'd have hated that, so I'll do it twice as grand.
Bring the white cap to Brynja at Half-Moon Mill
Ragnhild gathered these for your boy. She didn't make it out.
story.skycraft.q.pl_greywater_grotto.out: Brynja's boy is up and about by Turdas, complaining about the taste of mushroom milk.
story.skycraft.q.pl_greywater_grotto.pit: Ragnhild the herb-wife went into Greywater Grotto for white cap mushrooms. Brynja's boy at the mill is sick and needs them. Ragnhild hasn't come back.
story.skycraft.q.pl_greywater_grotto.tit: White Cap for a Sick Boy
story.skycraft.q.pl_gyldenhul_barrow.des: Yrsa Seal-Singer's nephew Brandr went into Gyldenhul Barrow alone to prove himself in the old Skaal way, carrying his father's seal-tooth spear.
Brandr is dead. He fell in the warden's hall, with three broken draugr around him and his father's spear still in his hand.
He fell fighting. Three draugr lay broken around him.
Then the old men will talk about him after all. I will cut his name on the stair myself. Give me the spear; it goes to the next hunter who has more sense than he did.
He should never have gone. Tell the young ones the truth: the proving kills.
...Yes. I will tell them that, and I will tell them his name with it, so they remember both. Give me the spear. It will hang over the door, and nobody will take it into that barrow again.
Your face tells me before your mouth does. Tell me how.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gyldenhul_barrow.out: There is a new name on the stair of Gyldenhul Barrow. Yrsa cut it herself, deep enough that the wind will not wear it away for a long time.
story.skycraft.q.pl_gyldenhul_barrow.pit: My nephew Brandr took his father's spear and went into Gyldenhul Barrow to prove himself, though the old proving is long done with. He said not to send anyone who did not want to go. Do you want to go?
story.skycraft.q.pl_haafingar_stormcloak: A Stormcloak soldier, Ragnvald, wrote a letter to his mother Hulda in Dragon Bridge and never sent it. He asked that a friend carry it home.
Find Ragnvald's unsent letter in the Stormcloak camp
From Ragnvald? ...He can see our chimney. The fool can see our chimney and he never once came down. I'll keep this under my pillow. Don't tell him I cried. Tell him I threw it in the fire.
Carry the letter to Hulda in Dragon Bridge
Your son Ragnvald wrote to you. He couldn't send it himself.
That night a lamp burns in Hulda's window until dawn, facing the hills.
There's a Dragon Bridge boy up in the rebel camp. Hulda's eldest. She'd give her right arm for a word from him, and I hear he's written one he hasn't the nerve to send.
story.skycraft.q.pl_haknirs_shoal.desc: The articles of Haknir Death-Brand's crew bind his drowned oarsmen to their benches through a brand-iron kept in the captain's chest. As long as it lies there, they row.
story.skycraft.q.pl_haknirs_shoal.o0.tex: Lay the drowned oarsmen of the Death-Brand to rest
story.skycraft.q.pl_haknirs_shoal.o2.jou: With the brand-iron out of the chest, the water around the wreck is finally still.
story.skycraft.q.pl_haknirs_shoal.o2.tex: Take the brand-iron from the captain's chest
story.skycraft.q.pl_haknirs_shoal.outro: The fishermen of the north shore say the shoal is quiet now. One of them swears he heard thirty-one voices sigh at once, the night the iron left the wreck.
story.skycraft.q.pl_haknirs_shoal.pitch: On still nights you can hear oars at Haknir's Shoal. The old crew swore an oath on some iron of the captain's. Take the iron out of the wreck, they say, and the oars will stop.
story.skycraft.q.pl_haknirs_shoal.title: Leave the Oar
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.desc: Bersi's son Thorvi lost his dead mother's pendant to the warden of Halldir's Cairn. Bersi believes the boy's nightmares will end only when it is returned.
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.o1.te: Defeat the warden in the iron mask
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.o2.jo: The warden wore a dozen trinkets taken from trespassers over the centuries. The little bronze hammer was the newest.
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.o2.te: Take Signy's pendant from the warden
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.o3.re: That's hers. That's... Thorvi! Come here, son. No, it's all right, it's warm now, see? I'll make a box for it. A good box, with a lock. And I'll make you a bow, since you're so set on that archer girl in the hills.
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.o3.te: Return the pendant to Bersi in Falkreath
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.offer: You look like you haven't slept, carpenter.
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.outro: Thorvi sleeps through the night for the first time in a month, and wakes asking when he can start archery lessons.
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.pitch: My boy Thorvi went into Halldir's Cairn on a dare. He came out, thank Arkay, but he left his mother's pendant behind. He says a dead man in an iron mask took it from his neck. He hasn't slept a night since. Please. Bring it back, and maybe the dreams will stop.
story.skycraft.q.pl_halldirs_cairn.title: Signy's Pendant
story.skycraft.q.pl_halted_stream_camp.d: Bandits at Halted Stream Camp are working an old mine with farmhands taken from Loreius Farm. Their chief, Brattvar Stone-Hand, keeps the key to the chains on his belt.
story.skycraft.q.pl_halted_stream_camp.o: Clear the bandits from Halted Stream Camp
Ulf and Asbjorn of Loreius Farm are free. They ran for home without stopping to thank me, which I can hardly blame them for.
Take the shackle key and free the miners
The miners of Loreius Farm made it home. The mine at Halted Stream has fallen silent.
story.skycraft.q.pl_halted_stream_camp.p: Vantus Loreius thinks his missing farmhands ran off. They didn't. The bandits at Halted Stream have them digging in chains. Someone ought to go and break those chains.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hamvirs_rest.desc: A grave-robber's notes tell of his friend Skeggi, left behind in Hamvir's Rest when the dead chieftain woke. He begs anyone brave enough to put Hamvir down.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hamvirs_rest.o1.text: Put Hamvir the Patient back to rest
story.skycraft.q.pl_hamvirs_rest.o2.jour: Skeggi lay at the foot of Hamvir's throne. I left the axe across the chieftain's knees, where it belongs, and took only the boy's luck-charm.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hamvirs_rest.outro: Hamvir waits again, his axe across his knees. Skeggi's charm should go to someone who will bury it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hamvirs_rest.pitch: Two robbers went into Hamvir's Rest after an old axe. One came out screaming. If you've got a strong arm, the dead in there need putting back to bed.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hamvirs_rest.title: Hamvir Does Not Rest
story.skycraft.q.pl_harmugstahl.desc: A shepherd's note found in Harmugstahl names the mage Ostrel Vane, who feeds travellers to the giant spiders he breeds behind the fort's walls.
story.skycraft.q.pl_harmugstahl.o3.journ: Vane's notes describe glyphs that bind beasts to a place. The College would want them. Perhaps nobody should have them.
story.skycraft.q.pl_harmugstahl.outro: Without its master, Harmugstahl is quiet. The webs in the walls will take years to fall.
story.skycraft.q.pl_harmugstahl.pitch: Shepherd from Karthwasten took sheep to the wizard at Harmugstahl and never came back. His wife won't hear he ran off. Something's eating people in that fort, and it isn't the wizard. Not directly.
story.skycraft.q.pl_harmugstahl.title: The Spider-Wright
story.skycraft.q.pl_helas_folly.desc: Captain Hela of the frozen ship Hela's Folly hid a strongbox of silver plate ashore before her crew died in the ice. Her last note describes where.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helas_folly.o0.text: Board the wreck of Hela's Folly
story.skycraft.q.pl_helas_folly.o1.journ: Wrapped in an old mainsail, weighted with the ship's bell: Hela's silver plate. Most of it is tarnished past saving, but a fine silver ring was packed among it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helas_folly.o1.text: Dig up the plate by the crooked doorway of rock
story.skycraft.q.pl_helas_folly.outro: You drink to Hela Wave-Bride, who was right about the route and wrong about the weather.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helas_folly.pitch: They say the captain of Hela's Folly buried her cargo somewhere on the shore before the ice took her. Nobody's ever found it. Nobody's tried very hard, either.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helas_folly.title: Hela's Plate
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.desc: Ylva, a refugee from Helgen living in Riverwood, asks you to recover her father's strongbox from beneath his forge before looters take it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.o0.text: Go to the ruins of Helgen
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.o1.journal: The scavengers were already prying at the forge stones. The box is heavy and still warm from the ash.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.o1.text: Find Torolf's strongbox under the smithy by the north gate
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.o2.reply: It's his mark on the lid. He made the lock himself. Here's Mother's ring... and the wedding money. He saved it for years, and I'm not even promised to anyone. Take a share. He'd want you paid. He always paid his debts.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.o2.text: Bring the strongbox to Ylva in Riverwood
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.outro: Ylva wears her mother's ring on a cord around her neck, and she has stopped asking travellers about Helgen.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.pitch: My father was the smith by the north gate. He kept a strongbox under the forge floor with my mother's ring in it. I can't go back there. I've tried; I get as far as the bridge and my legs stop. Scavengers are picking the town clean. Please, before they find it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_helgen.title: What the Fire Left
story.skycraft.q.pl_high_gate_ruins.desc: Surveyor Decimus Calvo of the Imperial Geographic Society went deeper into High Gate Ruins to finish his map. His satchel holds the only copy.
story.skycraft.q.pl_high_gate_ruins.o0.j: Calvo died at his drawing board in the last chamber, pencil still in hand. The map is finished except for one room.
story.skycraft.q.pl_high_gate_ruins.o1.t: Defeat the gate-warden of the old cult
story.skycraft.q.pl_high_gate_ruins.o2.t: Bring the map to the Legion at the Pale Imperial Camp
story.skycraft.q.pl_high_gate_ruins.outr: The Society will publish Calvo's map with a black border. The last room is marked simply: 'Do not.'
story.skycraft.q.pl_high_gate_ruins.pitc: There was an Imperial mapmaker went into High Gate Ruins. Wouldn't leave without finishing his map. I suppose he's finished now, one way or the other.
story.skycraft.q.pl_highpoint_tower.desc: The Telvanni wizard Arvyn Hlervu left a guardian of fire and ash in Highpoint Tower with one order: let no one up the stair who is not him. He never came back, and it never stopped walking.
story.skycraft.q.pl_highpoint_tower.o0.t: Unbind the guardian in the top chamber
story.skycraft.q.pl_highpoint_tower.o1.j: The grimoire is full of star charts and pages of notes on the fires of Red Mountain. Arvyn was right: the mountain is only sleeping.
story.skycraft.q.pl_highpoint_tower.o1.t: Take Arvyn's grimoire from the top chamber
story.skycraft.q.pl_highpoint_tower.outr: The stair of Highpoint Tower is quiet. Whatever Arvyn found out about Red Mountain, you are now the only one who knows it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_highpoint_tower.pitc: Something burning walks round and round the top of Highpoint Tower. The wizard who left it there has been gone eleven years. His books are still up there, if you can get past his watchdog.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hillgrunds_tomb.desc: A grave-robber stole Hillgrund's drinking horn from his bier and woke the tomb. Hillgrund's descendants can no longer bury their dead there.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hillgrunds_tomb.o0.j: The robber never left the side passage. The horn lay in his lap.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hillgrunds_tomb.o0.t: Find the stolen horn in the side passage
story.skycraft.q.pl_hillgrunds_tomb.o2.j: The horn is back on the bier. The tomb is silent.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hillgrunds_tomb.o2.t: Return the horn to Hillgrund's bier
story.skycraft.q.pl_hillgrunds_tomb.outr: In spring, Ingrun Hillgrund-Kin lays Torvar's urn with the rest of the line. Nothing stirs.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hillgrunds_tomb.pitc: Hillgrund's kin can't lay their dead in the old tomb anymore. Something's awake in there, and they say it's looking for a stolen horn.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hobs_fall_cave.desc: Vinicia Sallus, expelled from the College for necromancy, stole a restricted book from the Arcanaeum and now raises the drowned in Hob's Fall Cave.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hobs_fall_cave.o2.te: Recover the Concordance of the Unquiet
story.skycraft.q.pl_hobs_fall_cave.o3.re: Oh, the Arcanaeum's keeper will be thrilled. Thrilled is perhaps strong. He will grunt slightly less. I always said she had talent. I also always said she would end badly. I dislike being right about both.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hobs_fall_cave.o3.te: Return the book to the College through Quaestor Vesk
story.skycraft.q.pl_hobs_fall_cave.o3.to: The Concordance of the Unquiet, from Hob's Fall.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hobs_fall_cave.outro: The Legion camp's lost patrols are buried properly this time, on land.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hobs_fall_cave.pitch: There's a woman in Hob's Fall raising the drowned. The College threw her out years back. Now the Legion patrols keep disappearing and turning up on the beach, standing in the surf.
story.skycraft.q.pl_hobs_fall_cave.title: The Concordance of the Unquiet
story.skycraft.q.pl_honeystrand_cave.des: A forgetful beekeeper hid his wax money near Honeystrand Cave, thirty paces east under a flat stone, where the bears are less likely to dig.
Under the flat stone: a pouch of wax money and a gold ring. A bear watched me dig, just as the note promised.
Dig under the flat stone thirty paces east of Honeystrand Cave
story.skycraft.q.pl_honeystrand_cave.out: Rolf's stash is found. He'll be digging in the wrong place for a while yet.
story.skycraft.q.pl_honeystrand_cave.pit: Rolf the beekeeper buried his coin by Honeystrand Cave and forgot where. He's been digging up half the hillside. Bears watch him do it.
story.skycraft.q.pl_horker_island.desc: A salvager buried the purser's coin from Haknir Death-Brand's ship on Horker Island, under the flat stone where the old bull horker sleeps, twenty paces north of the island's middle.
